# Owais Ahmad

> AI & Data Science Manager with 7+ years building enterprise-scale Generative AI, LLM, and MLOps systems across government and enterprise domains. Currently at the Ministry of Electronics & Information Technology (NeGD), Government of India.

## About
- Name: Owais Ahmad
- Role: AI & Data Science Manager
- Location: New Delhi, India
- Focus: Generative AI, LLM systems, Agentic AI, RAG pipelines, LLM evaluation, MLOps, biomedical NLP.
- Prior: Senior AI Engineer at IBM (watsonx.ai, IBM Granite); Data Scientist Consultant at Hindustan Unilever (Azure OpenAI); Data Scientist at Canary Global.
- Education: M.Tech in Statistical Computing (Data Science), Jawaharlal Nehru University (JNU); GATE qualified. B.Tech CS & IT, MANUU.
